en: A vintage black-and-white panoramic view over the historic city center of Bruges, showing dense rows of traditional European rooftops and narrow streets. Dominating the skyline is a tall medieval bell tower rising above a large rectangular complex, likely the belfry on the Markt square. At the upper left of the front side, printed text reads "Bruges   Panorama". The overall design and tonality resemble an early 20th‑century tourist postcard.
